summary: Independent first pass found two medium issues, both corrected and independently rechecked. Integration later found PostgreSQL snapshot row-order instability; its narrowly scoped normalization correction also passed reviewer source inspection and 14 direct token-binding checks. No unresolved supported finding remains within the reviewed scopes. Full integration acceptance belongs to the lead.
evidence: independent-review-worker-report.json: original findings, reproduction commands, source digests and limitations.
independent-review-recheck.json: both original findings independently verified as corrected.
independent-review-order-recheck.json: token ordering correction checked with 14 direct binding assertions.
limitations: This is a focused follow-up informed by the integration regression and proposed fix, not a new independent first pass. The two original review findings and their earlier corrections remain recorded separately.

The 14-case reviewer check exercises actual token construction with isolated dependency stubs; it does not execute database transactions. PostgreSQL plan switching and both-backend proposal suites were performed by the implementation worker, with final integration checks owned by the lead. No browser, build, full-suite, or product source edits were performed during this follow-up.
